All modules

page

layout · 0.4.1 · A2 · aj-l-page

The graph page: the ruled paper everything on a screen is written on. Full width at 390; from 700 an object of its own, exactly 40 graph modules wide (--page-w) and centred, running the full height; at 1200 it starts at the title block's edge. A split page lays its content in two columns at desktop.

token--aj-l-page-leadexposed: The space above a single page's first object at desktop, by its head (data-head); the split page starts its columns there too.
token--aj-l-page-overflowexposed: How far a scrolled iOS page has moved (scrolled): set by whoever shows the state; the mobile-app comp sets 292px in lock.css.
token--aj-l-page-lead-setexposed: An override of the lead the website's runtime sets on its navbar page (0): it drops the lead.
token--aj-l-page-view-heightexposed: The height of a navbar page: the view less the browser's own furniture, set by the app (the website runtime) as it lays the page out.
